evidence: WHOCC ATC/DDD Index, group J01DH Carbapenems (index last updated 2026-01-20): J01DH51 is 'imipenem and cilastatin' with the note 'Refers to imipenem'; J01DH56 'imipenem, cilastatin and relebactam' also refers to imipenem; no code names imipenem alone.
note: Owner decision 2026-11-08 (drug-resolution DP43, cascade-engine DP23). Imipenem is marketed only with cilastatin; the WHO classification gives it no code of its own, and another carbapenem's code would be a proxy, which is forbidden. Cilastatin gets no carbapenem code. J01DH51 stays a combination code for every other ingredient.
